title: Replication package: Pareto-Based MCDM Under Normalization and Aggregation Uncertainty — Landfill Site Selection on Fogo Island, Cabo Verde

creators.name: Azancort Neto, Julio Leite
creators.affiliation: Instituto de Tecnologia, Universidade Federal do Para (UFPA), Belem, PA, Brazil

description:
Replication package for Comparing SAW and TOPSIS under normalization and aggregation uncertainty: a Pareto-based Monte Carlo study for landfill site selection on Fogo Island, Cabo Verde (under review at Omega, Elsevier).

Contents: (i) input data for 473 candidate landfill sites on Fogo Island; (ii) pre-registration documents for six sub-experiments and the main factorial; (iii) pre-computed Monte Carlo results (4000 draws, kappa=200 primary; kappa=50 robustness check); (iv) bootstrap contrast files for all main factorial cells; (v) Python scripts to reproduce all experiments, bootstrap analyses, LaTeX macros, and manuscript figures; (vi) the LaTeX manuscript source.

The study applies a 2x2x2 factorial design (normalization x aggregation x assembly) across SAW and TOPSIS, computing exact Pareto frontiers over weight uncertainty. The key finding is that normalization is the dominant driver of ranking disagreement (+29 to +33 pp), while aggregation and assembly effects are conditional on the concentration parameter kappa.
